title: List all closed schools in the county that has the highest number of closed
question: List all closed schools in the county that has the highest number of closed schools, where the school is located in a city with total K–12 enrollment (across all schools) under 5,000 students. Return the school name, closure date, and city.

prediction.sql:
WITH closed_schools AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_045, s.XCL_047, s.XCL_050, s.XCL_062
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT XCL_045, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM closed_schools
  GROUP BY XCL_045
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
city_enrollment AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_050, SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_enrollment
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  GROUP BY s.XCL_050
)
SELECT cs.XCL_047, cs.XCL_062, cs.XCL_050
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs.XCL_045 = tc.XCL_045
JOIN city_enrollment ce ON cs.XCL_050 = ce.XCL_050
WHERE ce.total_enrollment < 5000

WITH closed_schools AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_045, s.XCL_047, s.XCL_050, s.XCL_062
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT XCL_045, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM closed_schools
  GROUP BY XCL_045
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
city_enrollment AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_050, SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_enrollment
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  GROUP BY s.XCL_050
)
SELECT cs.XCL_047, cs.XCL_062, cs.XCL_050
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs.XCL_045 = tc.XCL_045
JOIN city_enrollment ce ON cs.XCL_050 = ce.XCL_050
WHERE ce.total_enrollment < 5000

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH closed_schools AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_042, s.XCL_043, s.XCL_045, s.XCL_062
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT XCL_042, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM closed_schools
  GROUP BY XCL_042
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
city_enrollment AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_045, SUM(f.XCL_013) AS total_enrollment
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  GROUP BY s.XCL_045
)
SELECT cs.XCL_043, cs.XCL_062, cs.XCL_045
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs.XCL_042 = tc.XCL_042
JOIN city_enrollment ce ON cs.XCL_045 = ce.XCL_045
WHERE ce.total_enrollment < 5000

FROM schools s

  AND s.XCL_046 = (
      SELECT XCL_046

      GROUP BY XCL_046
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

      SELECT XCL_044
